Server sockets

+
    +

  • {@systemProperty jdk.net.ServerSocket.IP_TOS} (default: false)
    + When set to {@code true}, ignoring case, this property allows applications to set + and query {@link java.net.StandardSocketOptions#IP_TOS IP_TOS} on a server socket + using the JDK's default {@link java.net.ServerSocket ServerSocket} implementation, + including before a connection is accepted. Otherwise, the option is not supported. + When using the default implementation, this property also controls whether + {@code IP_TOS} is included in the option set returned by + {@code jdk.net.Sockets.supportedOptions(ServerSocket.class)}. + The option's effects, including inheritance by accepted sockets, are + platform dependent. Support on {@code Socket} and + {@code DatagramSocket} is not affected.

    +
+

This property is checked only once, when the default socket implementation is +initialized. Set it on the command line when starting the JVM.
